_comment: Condensed from Apollo 12's CSM checklists (data/missions/apollo_12/checklists.json) for Apollo 13's flight: MCC-2 onto the hybrid trajectory, the oxygen tank's failure, the power-down and Odyssey dark while Aquarius flies the stack, the entry batteries charged from the LM, SM SEP, the CM's power-up and alignment, LM JETT and the entry [adapted for this simulator; the flight's own procedures were written in the hours after the failure]. Keys: V/N/Enter = VERB/NOUN/ENTR, Space = PRO. control: the cabin control a step is done on (an id in data/cockpit/controls.csv); without it the checklist highlight finds the control that writes the step's check channel. phases: the flight phases (mission.phase) a checklist is for, or tank_failure, the start minutes before the failure; it opens at the start, and as the crew comes back aboard Odyssey, in one. Aquarius's are in lm_checklists.json.

steps.text: Watch the S-IVB/IU: TLI is automatic at the GO-for-TLI TIG
TLI ignition
TLI cutoff: verify apogee beyond the Moon (V82E)
CSM/LV SEP: transposition, docking and LM extraction
UP TLM CM - ACCEPT, in P00, for the ground's uplink
Mission Control: the PAD (P27 takes the state vector and the P30 loads: UPLINK ACTY)
UP TLM CM - BLOCK
V37E 30E - P30 External Delta-V
Verify TIG (N33), PRO; verify N81 DV, PRO; check N42, PRO
P52 option 1, the preferred REFSMMAT (IMU realign)
CMC MODE - AUTO
V37E 40E - P40 SPS Thrusting
V50N18 flashing: PRO to maneuver to burn attitude
DELTA-V THRUST A - NORMAL
DELTA-V THRUST B - NORMAL (both banks for a long burn; bank A alone for a short one)
At TIG-5 s V99N40 flashing: PRO for engine on
Monitor V16N40 (TFI, VG, DV) - SPS cutoff
DELTA-V THRUST A and B - OFF
Trim N85 residuals with the THC, then PRO
For the small midcourse corrections, a few feet a second
UP TLM CM - ACCEPT, in P00, for the ground's uplink
Mission Control: the PAD (P27 takes the state vector and the P30 loads)
V37E 30E - P30 External Delta-V
Verify TIG (N33), PRO; verify N81 DV, PRO; check N42, PRO
CMC MODE - AUTO
V37E 41E - P41 RCS Thrusting
V50N18 flashing: PRO to maneuver to the burn attitude, +X along the delta-V
At TIG-5 s V99 flashing: PRO; the four +X jets fire
Monitor V16N85 (VG) to zero
Trim N85 residuals with the THC, then PRO

checklists.title: The oxygen tank failure and the lifeboat

steps.text: Houston's call: stir up the cryo tanks [the tanks' fans are not modelled]
A bang, the master alarm, MAIN B UNDERVOLT: "Houston, we've had a problem"
FUEL CELL 1 and 3 lights: both off-line; O2 tank 2 at zero, tank 1 falling
Houston: the emergency power-down
CM POWER - EMER: 10 A off fuel cell 2
Houston: get over into the LM; Aquarius's activation is its checklist
Aquarius powered
Houston: Odyssey's gimbal angles (V16N20) to Aquarius for its coarse align
O2 tank 1 empty: fuel cell 2 stops (about 58:15), the CM on its entry batteries
Houston: power the CSM down
Aquarius: LGC MODE - HOLD, its DAP takes the stack
CM POWER - OFF: Odyssey dark
Aquarius flies the free return and PC+2 on its descent engine (its checklists)
Houston: charge the entry batteries from Aquarius
LM PWR - ON: Aquarius's power charges the entry batteries
MCC-7 on Aquarius's jets, then the AGS holding: CM/SM SEP
Photograph the SM as it drifts off: one whole panel gone
Houston: the CM's coarse align angles, Aquarius's gimbals through the docking
Houston: power the CM up
CMC MODE - FREE
CM POWER - ALL
LM PWR - OFF
UP TLM CM - ACCEPT, in P00, for the state vector and the REFSMMAT
V41N20E: load the PAD's gimbal angles, coarse align
The REFSMMAT uplinked (UPLINK ACTY), its flag set
UP TLM CM - BLOCK
P52 option 3, the REFSMMAT, on the stars (IMU realign)
Houston: GO for LM JETT
LM JETT: the tunnel's pressure pushes Aquarius off
CMC MODE - HOLD
Houston: the entry PAD, then the final state vector (UP TLM CM - ACCEPT)
V37E 61E - P61 Entry preparation: PRO at N61 (the target, HEADSUP -1 lift up), N60 and N63 (the EMS's)
CMC MODE - AUTO
P62 V50N25 00041, the SM gone since 138 hours: PRO, and PRO at N61: the entry attitude (N22), then P63 (N64)
SCS ATT SOURCE - CMC (the CMC rolls the lift)
ELS LOGIC - ON
ELS AUTO
0.05 g: P64 entry guidance (N74: roll, velocity, drag)
P65 up-control if the range asks for it (PRO at the flashing V16N69); P67 final phase (N66)
1,000 ft/s: PRO at the flashing V16N67 (range to go, latitude, longitude) - P00
Drogues at 24,000 ft
Mains at 10,000 ft
Splashdown
At the LEB (SEAT): OPTICS ZERO - OFF, MODE - CMC
V37E 52E - P52 IMU realign
V04N06: V22E option E (1 PREF 2 NOM 3 REFS 4 LS); PRO
V06N22 new gimbal angles, MG under 70: PRO, coarse align
V50N25 00015: PRO for two stars (00405: roll heads down)
Star 1: PRO at V01N70; OPTICS MAN, centre it, MARK
Star 2: OPTICS CMC, PRO at V01N70; MAN, centre, MARK
V06N05 star angle difference under 0.02: PRO
V06N93 torquing angles: PRO to torque the gyros
V50N25 00014: V37E 00E; OPTICS MODE - CMC
